title: First user run and show commands
goal: Expose one durable admitted Codex execution and its persisted history through the ymp command-line interface.
scope: Implement ymp run with a task argument, documented durable data directory, one admitted Codex invocation, bounded observation, settlement, and an honest terminal report.
Implement ymp show for a persisted session and its invocation history.
Keep unattended tests on ScriptedBackend and retain real provider execution only in an ignored test.
Add only the minimal runtime facade required to assemble Registry, ExecutionBackend, and SqliteJournal without moving authority into the CLI.
acceptance: run constructs the canonical Task values, persists the session, executes exactly one admitted scenario, and reports the observed outcome, usage, workspace, and session ID.
The default ./.ymp/sessions location, file lifetime, and default execution limits are documented in help, and a missing codex executable produces a typed readable error.
show reopens the durable journal and prints the session status and invocation history.
Unattended tests cover completed, failed, not-ready registry, and reopen persistence; real Codex execution remains ignored.
Workspace build, formatting, Clippy, tests, task-record validation, and independent review succeed before the result is committed to main.
context: Requested directly against main after DEV-0013; no push is authorized.
